tagline: Global leader in commercial aircraft, defense, space and security solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The BCA segment represents approximately 46% of total revenue and is the primary driver of growth and financial volatility, with significant leverage on aircraft deliveries and the post-crisis recovery of the air travel market.

kpis.name: Commercial Airplanes Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of commercial aircraft such as the 737, 777 and 787.
kpis.description: Revenue increased significantly in 2025 due to higher deliveries, despite disruptions related to the 737-9 incident in 2024.
kpis.signal: Strong rebound following the 2024 quality crisis

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improved from -16.1% in 2024 to 4.8% in 2025, driven by production recovery and increased deliveries.
kpis.signal: Return to profitability after three years of losses

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total consolidated revenue from all combined segments.
kpis.description: Total revenue increased by 34.5% in 2025, driven by BCA, BDS and BGS, despite production disruptions.

kpis.name: Defense, Space Security Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from military contracts, satellites, defense systems and space programs.
kpis.description: The BDS segment saw revenue growth in 2025 due to reduced negative contract adjustments and improved operational performance.

kpis.name: Global Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from maintenance, training, spare parts and digital services for commercial and military customers.
kpis.description: BGS shows steady growth, driven by demand for commercial and government services.

kpis.name: Core Operating Earnings
kpis.explanation: Operating income excluding exceptional items such as pension-related charges.
kpis.description: Core operating earnings improved from -$11.8B in 2024 to +$3.2B in 2025, reflecting operational stabilization.

kpis.name: 737 Deliveries Impact
kpis.explanation: Impact of 737 aircraft deliveries on BCA revenue.
kpis.description: 737 deliveries resumed in 2025 after a pause in 2024 due to the January incident, leading to a strong increase in BCA revenue.
kpis.signal: Key rebound following the door plug incident

kpis.name: Spirit Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Spirit AeroSystems to vertically integrate fuselage manufacturing.
kpis.description: The December 2025 acquisition enabled Boeing to regain control of 737, 767, 777 and 787 fuselage production, integrating approximately 15,000 employees.

risks.title: Debt
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant borrowings and is subject to debt covenants, which may affect its credit rating.

risks.title: Regulatory
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict government regulations, particularly regarding pension and post-retirement matters.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company is involved in legal disputes and proceedings, which may negatively impact its financials.

risks.title: Environmental
risks.score_rationale: The company is involved in environmental remediation activities, which may negatively impact its financials.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on technology for its operations, making it vulnerable to security breaches and disruptions.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, which may negatively impact its sales and profits.

risks.title: Geopolitical
risks.score_rationale: The company operates internationally, exposing it to geopolitical risks and disruptions.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning or related technologies is present in Boeing's 2025 10-K filing.
